events.title: Update V0.62: Unit Grouping is Finally Here!
events.summary: Unit Grouping (At Last) Unit grouping is here. When you select multiple units, a small + button appears in the top left. Click it to create a group, and you can instantly select them later using the hotkey or the UI button. Received a lot of feedback on this oneTactical Pause Before the Battle Battles no longer start instantly.
